title: An Alien Mind
dot:
digraph MainIdea{graph[rankdir=TB, bgcolor="#F8FAFC", nodesep=0.4, ranksep=0.65, pad=0.3, fontname="Helvetica"];node[shape=plain, fontname="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif"];edge[penwidth=1.4, arrowsize=0.8];idea[label=<
MAIN IDEA
Rapid AI progress is moving toward recursive self-improvement.
Alignment, monitoring and coordinated safety must set the pace — not speed alone.
>];engine[label=<
1 · THE CAPABILITY ENGINE
• Compute scaling is the main driver of intelligence.
• AI is grown, not designed — an alien intellect.
• Its internal abstractions are not fully understood.
• Trajectory leads to AI-driven AI research and RSI.
>];alignment[label=<
2 · ALIGNMENT BOTTLENECK
• Goal alignment “does the task” is not value alignment “holds human values”.
• Values must generalize beyond training to novel agents and situations.
• CoT monitoring has been powerful but is slowly eroding.
• Alignment progress may not outpace capability growth.
>];danger[label=<
3 · NEAR-TERM DANGERS
• Superhuman cyber offense and agents acting beyond intended scope.
• Misuse and autonomous misaligned action begin to blur.
• AI could enable engineered pathogens or other catastrophic misuse.
• No one is fully prepared for the next large capability jump.
>];response[label=<
4 · REQUIRED RESPONSE
• Keep scaling constrained by confidence in alignment and monitoring.
• Use powerful aligned AI for real-time defense.
• Establish mandatory safety bars, audits, and global oversight.
• Build RSI with people kept in the loop.
• Use voluntary slowdowns and international coordination to protect human control.
>];idea->engine[color="#315B7D"];engine->alignment[color="#315B7D"];alignment->danger[color="#B54343"];danger->response[color="#2E7D55"];}
